changes: 2027 tipping: XP for each round will pay out (it was going to skip every round already paid in 2026)
Tipping season points reset to 0 for the new season
A fixtures feed outage no longer shows as 'no games'
Removed Syndy Voice (and its health-check warning)
Casino Pot: closed weeks are settled by the server only (the in-app catch-up could never finish under the database rules); health check explains what the server will do
Group multi shows on Home as soon as the bets are entered — legs without a result yet show as ⏳ Pending (Home used to wait until someone had a Win/Loss)
Save Week warns if any leg has odds but no result
Group multi entries no longer disappear: the real cause was the Ledger app overwriting the whole shared data on most of its actions. The Dashboard now spots that and puts the rows straight back
Fixed the Dashboard holding onto its own copy of the group multi for the rest of a session after any edit
Footy Tipping now only shows the current season set in Archive & start new season — last season's games and ladder no longer carry over
Round names come from the fixture: no Opening Round from 2027, Gather Round detected automatically, finals named from the feed
Admin submissions tracker no longer counts last season's picks for the same round number
Archiving a season twice now asks before overwriting the saved ladder
Casino Pot: a week where nobody qualified now carries its pot into the current week instead of getting stuck forever; already-paid leftovers clean themselves up
Casino Pot payouts can no longer overwrite (or be overwritten by) a player's own game winnings, and failed payouts are recorded
Health check: fixed three false alarms (weekly pot key format, top-up week marker, older weeks without group-multi detail) and it now explains why a pot period is stuck
Save Week now warns if nobody in the Group Multi table has a result picked
Group multi entries no longer disappear: background refresh can't overwrite unsaved edits, saves only send edited rows, and unsent edits are recovered on next launch
Money-critical writes (Save Week, members, history, group) now verify the server accepted them; 15s poll skips redundant re-renders
Faster startup: Firebase live-table SDK only loads when a live table opens; Maxine's images compressed and lazy-loaded
Battery: background timers pause while the app is hidden; Mini Golf stops drawing when you leave Casino; approval check stops once approved
Fix: Maxine's wins threw an error after crediting, so wins never reached the live feed or milestones
Smoother animations: tier gems, casino button sheens and coin shines now GPU-animated
